title_seed: 不要把十篇來源接成一篇
central_problem: 來源很多是否自然形成一個有回答力的研究報告？
reader_takeaway: synthesis 應按研究問題組織 claim，而不是照 provider/source card 順序貼接。

known_at_the_time.fact: 80fbcbb 明確將 report synthesis 從 source-card pasting 重構開。
5cd5e48 增加 accepted-source synthesis helper，ed05b87 形成 evidence-based report flow。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: accepted sources/evidence cards 成為 synthesis 的輸入，Writer 不再只是把來源摘要逐篇接起來。

not_yet_available.fact: claim graph、two-pass Writer、Study Facts V2 與 canonical admission 尚未可視為此階段既存。

observed_failures.symptom: source-by-source assembly could produce a report-shaped sequence without a question-shaped synthesis
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: synthesis responsibility had been too close to card transport
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: accepted sources should ground the draft
observed_failures.later_resolution: later claim graphs and post-edit validation made this boundary more explicit

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: Two committed synthesis milestones are identifiable: 80fbcbb and 5cd5e48.
tests_and_metrics.result: historical milestones verified; not a quality score

engineering_decisions.decision: 把 synthesis 從 card paste 改成依研究問題組織的 report flow。

architecture_state.state: accepted sources → evidence cards → synthesis/report writer → draft

safe_public_facts.fact: 『有很多來源』與『能回答研究問題』之間，必須有 synthesis layer。

retrospective_notes.note: 後來的 claim graph 與 sentence-level validation 是對 source-order echo 的後續回應，不能回寫成 6 月已完成。

publication_risks: 不要把 later two-pass Writer 當成早期 implementation。
避免用 source count 代替 synthesis quality。
